name: Chigusa 32-sai Hitozuma ~Kindan no Gifu Kaigo~
original_name: 千草32歳人妻～禁断の義父介護～
source:
Chigusa Nasuno, age 32.
Married to a hardworking husband, mother to a cute boy, caretaker to her husband's father.
They're a happy, normal household of four.
Yet... Chigusa's husband comes home late and exhausted.
It's a good marriage, but she has yearns for his embrace.
When they do have sex he finishes in a few short minutes in the missionary position.
It's not enough for Chigusa. Her sexual frustration has reached boiling point. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE126394.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
奈须野千草，32岁。

她嫁给勤劳的丈夫，育有可爱的儿子，还照顾丈夫的父亲。

这是一个幸福、普通的四口之家。

然而……千草的丈夫总是晚归，疲惫不堪。
婚姻很美满，但她渴望丈夫的拥抱。
他们发生性关系时，丈夫总是在传教士体位下几分钟便结束。

这对千草来说远远不够。她的性欲不满已经沸腾到极点。
